translation: Arjuna said: My delusion is destroyed, and through Your grace, O Infallible One, my true memory is regained. I am now firm, free from all doubts, and ready to act according to Your word.
sentences: Here is the triumphant climax of the entire dialogue—Arjuna's epic declaration of total awakening, clarity, and heroic readiness!
Listen to the four thunderous statements made by the transformed student in this single iconic verse.
First statement: Nasto Mohah—my delusion is completely destroyed!
The paralyzing fog of moral panic, emotional breakdown, and confused self-pity that crushed Arjuna in Chapter 1 has vanished without a trace!
Second statement: Smrtir Labdha Tvat-prasadan Maya Acyuta—through Your divine grace, O Infallible One, my true memory has been regained!
What is this 'memory' that Arjuna regained? It is the core memory of his eternal identity as a divine soul and his true purpose as a heroic warrior of light!

Awakening is not acquiring weird external facts; it is remembering your intrinsic strength, dignity, and divine nature that was there all along.
Third statement: Sthito 'smi Gata-sandehah—I stand firm, completely free from all doubts and hesitations!
Notice Arjuna's posture: he is no longer slumped down in the back of his chariot weeping with limp hands.
He stands upright, firm as a granite rock, with zero lingering doubt, double-mindedness, or internal conflict.
All the contradictory arguments, moral dilemmas, and intellectual objections have been completely resolved and integrated into perfect unity.
Fourth statement: Karisye Vacanam Tava—I will execute Your word and fulfill my duty with total commitment!
Notice how real wisdom concludes: not in endless passive talking or ivory-tower navel-gazing, but in decisive, courageous action!
Arjuna picks up his bow, steps to the front of his chariot, and prepares to execute his duty with absolute mastery.
This verse represents the absolute gold standard of complete psychological and spiritual transformation.
Imagine a person walking into a hospital broken, depressed, and confused, and walking out completely cured, energized, and ready to lead.
That total metamorphosis is what Bhagavad Gita delivers to anyone who absorbs its principles deeply.
This declaration proves that the teaching has succeeded 100% in achieving its ultimate purpose.
It inspires intense curiosity and deep obsession inside us to reach that exact same state of unshakeable clarity.
We want to reach a point in our own lives where we can say with total honesty: 'My delusion is gone, my doubts are dead, and I am ready to act!'
This state of mind renders you completely immune to manipulation, deception, panic, and existential depression.

sentences: We have arrived at the absolute final verse of the entire Bhagavad Gita, the legendary prophecy and formula for guaranteed success in human life.
Let us dissect the two essential components of this ultimate winning equation: Yatra Yogesvarah Krsno Yatra Partho Dhanur-dharah!
First component: Yogeshvara Krishna—representing supreme divine vision, eternal wisdom, moral clarity, and high-level strategy.
Second component: Partha Dhanur-dhara—Arjuna the archer holding his bow, representing active human effort, focused execution, and practical discipline.
Notice the staggering insight embedded in combining these two forces together!
If you have only Yogeshvara Krishna (vision and wisdom) without Partha (human effort and execution), you become a lazy daydreamer who talks big philosophy but accomplishes nothing in the real world.

If you have only Partha Dhanur-dhara (frantic physical hustle and effort) without Yogeshvara Krishna (wisdom, ethics, and vision), you become a mindless, stressed-out hamster running frantically on a wheel toward burnout and disaster.

First guarantee: Shri—unshakeable prosperity, wealth, abundance, and holistic well-being in all dimensions of life.
Second guarantee: Vijaya—absolute victory over internal weaknesses, self-doubt, external obstacles, and hostile challenges.
Third guarantee: Bhuti—continuous expansion, progress, innovation, and magnificent growth of human potential.
Fourth guarantee: Dhruva Niti—unshakeable moral integrity, sound ethics, and principled justice that keeps society stable and safe.
Sanjaya concludes with absolute, unyielding conviction: Matir Mama—this is my definitive, unshakeable verdict!
